title: 13-week cash-flow forecast dashboard for a retail chain
description: We run 6 retail stores and need a 13-week rolling cash-flow forecast with a simple web dashboard. Inputs are weekly sales exports, supplier payment terms and payroll dates. The dashboard should show opening/closing cash per week, a low-cash warning line and a scenario toggle for a 10% sales drop.

title: Three-statement financial model for a SaaS startup
description: Seed-stage SaaS company needs a linked three-statement model (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) for 36 months with MRR, churn and hiring plan drivers. Must be clean, documented and investor-ready. Current spreadsheets and assumptions will be shared.

title: Budget vs actual variance report automation
description: Automate our monthly budget vs actual variance report. Data comes from two CSV exports (budget and general ledger). Output an Excel workbook with variances by cost centre, highlighted over 10% and a short commentary template. Python or Power Query is fine.

title: Break-even and pricing analysis for a bakery
description: Small bakery wants a break-even analysis per product and a recommendation on pricing for 12 items. Ingredient costs and monthly overheads are TBD and will be confirmed after kickoff.

title: Crypto token treasury forecasting model
description: Build a treasury runway model for our crypto token project covering token unlocks, exchange listings and staking rewards over 24 months. Must include a Monte Carlo price scenario sheet.

title: Quick bookkeeping clean-up
description: Need someone to tidy up QuickBooks categories for last quarter.

title: React dashboard for internal sales KPIs
description: Build a React + TypeScript dashboard that reads from our existing REST API and shows daily sales, conversion and top products with date filters. Authentication is already handled. Charts should be responsive and the code should include basic tests.

title: FastAPI backend for an invoice tracker
description: We need a small FastAPI service with Postgres for tracking invoices: CRUD endpoints, due-date reminders and a CSV export. Docker setup and a README are required. Frontend already exists.

title: WordPress plugin bug fixes
description: Our custom WordPress booking plugin throws PHP warnings after the latest update and the calendar view breaks on mobile. Need fixes and a short changelog.

title: Mobile app MVP for a gambling tipster community
description: Build an iOS and Android app where members share betting tips, follow tipsters and see leaderboards. Flutter preferred. Payment integration for premium tipsters is required.

title: Next.js marketing site with CMS
description: Rebuild our marketing site in Next.js with a headless CMS so the team can edit pages. About 8 page templates, a blog, and Lighthouse scores above 90. Designs are ready in Figma.

title: Python script to reconcile bank and ledger exports
description: Write a Python script that matches bank statement lines to ledger entries by amount, date window and reference, outputs matched/unmatched reports and handles split payments. Sample files provided.

title: Customer churn analysis for a subscription box
description: Analyse 18 months of subscription data to find churn drivers. Deliver a notebook with cohort retention curves, a simple churn model with feature importance and a 2-page summary for non-technical managers.

title: SQL reporting views for a warehouse database
description: Create a set of SQL views and a few stored procedures on Postgres for weekly inventory, stock-out and supplier lead-time reports. Must be documented and performant on 5M rows.

title: Sales forecasting with seasonality
description: Forecast weekly sales for 40 SKUs for the next 26 weeks using 3 years of history. Compare a seasonal naive baseline with one ML approach, report accuracy (MAPE) and deliver forecasts as CSV.

title: Power BI dashboard from Excel files
description: Turn our monthly Excel sales files into a Power BI dashboard with region and product drill-down. Scope TBD after a call.

title: Web scraping of public property listings
description: Scrape public property listings from three regional sites into a clean dataset (price, size, location, date listed) and refresh it weekly. Must respect robots.txt and rate limits.

title: A/B test analysis for checkout redesign
description: We ran an A/B test on a new checkout page for 4 weeks. Need a proper statistical analysis (conversion, revenue per visitor, confidence intervals), a check for sample ratio mismatch and a clear recommendation.

title: Market research: SME accounting software in Pakistan
description: Desk research on the accounting software market for small and medium businesses in Pakistan: main vendors, pricing, adoption barriers and regulatory factors. Deliver a 10-page report with cited sources and a comparison table.

title: Competitor analysis for a project management tool
description: Compare our product with five competitors on features, pricing, positioning and reviews. Deliver a slide-ready summary and a spreadsheet matrix. Competitor list provided.

title: Literature review on cash-flow lending for SMEs
description: Academic-style literature review (about 4,000 words) on cash-flow based lending to small businesses: models used, default prediction evidence and regulatory views. APA referencing, peer-reviewed sources preferred.

title: Research supplier options for eco packaging
description: Find and compare 10 eco-friendly packaging suppliers in the EU.

title: Policy brief on digital payments adoption
description: Write a research-backed policy brief on digital payments adoption among small merchants in South Asia, with recommendations for a non-profit. Data sources and target length TBD with the client.

title: Due diligence summary of a target company
description: Prepare a concise commercial due diligence summary on a small B2B software company: market, customers, revenue quality and key risks, based on a data room we will share. Confidentiality agreement required.

title: Blog series on small-business cash management
description: Write six 1,200-word blog posts on cash management for small businesses (forecasting, payment terms, inventory, late invoices, buffers, tools). SEO keywords supplied; plain, practical tone.

title: Technical documentation for a REST API
description: Write developer documentation for our REST API: getting started, authentication, 25 endpoints with examples and error codes. OpenAPI spec is available. Output in Markdown for our docs site.

title: Grant proposal editing
description: Edit and tighten a 12-page grant proposal for a community health project. Improve clarity and flow, check consistency with the funder's criteria and keep within the page limit.

title: Product descriptions for 200 SKUs
description: Write short product descriptions for 200 kitchenware items.

title: Investor update newsletter writer
description: Ghostwrite a monthly investor update for a fintech startup from founder notes and KPI sheets: highlights, metrics, cash runway, asks. About 800 words, clear and honest tone. Ongoing work if the first one goes well.

title: Whitepaper on AI in accounts payable
description: Write a 3,000-word whitepaper on how AI is used in accounts payable automation: invoice capture, matching, fraud checks and ROI. Include two short case examples from public sources and a clear executive summary.
